title: Thai Ambrosial Curry with Tofu
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with ambrosial, tofu, and a blend of Thai spices.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice. Stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in Thai basil and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional Thai basil, if desired.
